_comment: Machine-readable hard limits. Read by tools/preflight.py before any order. Changing a value here is a POLICY CHANGE and must follow the RULEBOOK.md section 17 promotion path.

stop.note: Flat 5% default retired 2026-08-11 (EXP-007/008); stop stays volatility-scaled. No instrument is excluded on volatility -- governor decision 2026-08-11: any leveraged instrument may be traded if it meets the entry gates. The 7% cap still binds.

fractional.reason: PROHIBITED 2026-08-11. Verified by live order attempts: fractional accepts market orders only. limit -> 'Limit order quantity cannot include fractional shares'; stop_market gtc -> 'Invalid time in force for fractional order'; stop_market gfd -> 'Invalid trigger for fractional order'. A fractional position cannot carry a resting stop, and the entire exit model assumes the stop rests continuously at the broker (tools/replay.py). Whole shares only.
fractional.note: review_equity_order accepted both a fractional limit and a fractional stop_market and the broker then refused both at placement. Review does not validate fractional constraints; only an order response is evidence.

universe_note: Any liquid high-beta single name with a catalyst is also permitted by RULEBOOK section 4. preflight.py warns rather than denies on an off-list symbol, since the list is not exhaustive.

target.note: Sell at any checkpoint showing a gain AT OR ABOVE +8%. Replaced target = 2 x stop on 2026-08-11.

breakeven.note: Where the stop first moves to breakeven. Volatility-scaled per instrument, from data/vol_profile.csv.
breakeven.at_2_stalls: stop = max(current stop, breakeven) -- never lowered if the trail already carried it higher

stall.run_high: highest CHECKPOINT price since the fill, seeded at the fill price
stall.note: Governor decision 2026-08-11: the stall is measured at the checkpoint price only; what happens between checks is ignored. Intra-window highs from bars are no longer used, and the volume condition is REMOVED because volume has no instantaneous value. Stalls therefore fire strictly more often than before. WARNING: this couples the exit rule to the 30-minute cadence -- at a 10-minute cadence three stalls would fire after 30 minutes instead of 90. If the cadence changes, re-derive checks_to_sell in the same breath.
stall.at_2_stalls_underwater: SELL IMMEDIATELY at the market. Governor decision 2026-08-11. The ladder is asymmetric: 2 stalled checks sell a position below its fill, 3 are required for one at or above it. Cancel the resting stop first, then exit with a marketable limit. Do not wait for the next checkpoint.
stall.at_2_stalls_in_profit: Raise the stop to max(current stop, breakeven) and keep holding; the 3-check rule still applies.

commodity_trend_structure_gate.replaces: the section 4 named-catalyst requirement, for commodities and materials ONLY
legs: established multi-session higher highs AND higher lows
confirmation from the related complex (metal vs miners, crude vs E&P)
pullback not breakdown — inside the prior session's range, above its low
commodity_trend_structure_gate.note: Governor decision 2026-08-11. A replacement, not a relaxation: the stop, target, stall ladder, circuit breaker, floor and whole-share rule all still bind.
